add.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia; Australia section)
add.summary: Queensland placement policy: the 2009 Corrective Services procedure on transgender prisoners was assessed as largely ineffective (Jenny Samiec, Queensland Law Student Review 2009). Replacement oversight came via the Inspector of Detention Services Act 2022 (fully in force 2023), whose August 2023 inspection standards for Queensland prisons and youth detention centres direct that transgender and intersex prisoners are generally to be admitted to facilities corresponding to their lived or experienced gender. Staff still hold discretion at admission, and only transgender people who have undergone sexual reassignment surgery are excluded from that process - so Queensland placement is identity-based with a discretionary admission caveat and a surgery exception.
